sources.title: On the vanishing of reduced 1-cohomology for Banach representations
sources.version: Annales de l'Institut Fourier 70(5) (2020), 1951-2003, published PDF
locators: Definition 1.1, printed p. 1954: WAP_t and vanishing of reduced first cohomology
Corollary 1.9, printed p. 1957: real-triangulable Lie groups have WAP_t
sources.application: The strongly continuous unitary representation on the orthogonal complement of invariant vectors in L2 is WAP and has no invariant vectors.

sources.title: Ergodic decomposition of quasi-invariant probability measures
sources.version: Open author manuscript, 21 PDF pages; published in Colloquium Mathematicum 84/85(2) (2000), 495-514
locators: Theorem 5.2, PDF pp. 19-20: ergodic decomposition for a Borel action of a locally compact second countable group on a standard Borel space with prescribed Radon-Nikodym cocycle
sources.application: Take the Radon-Nikodym cocycle to be zero. The compact metrizable section is standard Borel; inversion changes the right action to the source's left-action convention.

sources.title: Hypoelliptic second order differential equations
sources.version: Acta Mathematica 119 (1967), 147-171, scan of published article
locators: Theorem 1.1, printed p. 149, PDF p. 3: hypoellipticity for a smooth real sum-of-squares operator with bracket-generating vector fields
sources.application: Use zero drift and zero zeroth-order term. The horizontal fields span the first layer of the graded nilpotent Lie algebra, hence bracket-generate; the continuous profile is a distribution with smooth zero right-hand side.
